answer: Each identity claims one orchard lease, locks 70 credits, and prices it at 120, paying 6 Harberger tax per epoch to the oasis registry. A meadow auditor can buy any lease at its price, so low prices lose leases and high prices bleed tax. A rented key on two leases voids both bonds. 1,000 fakes lock 70,000 and pay 6,000 tax per epoch, 130,000 over ten epochs against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent prices one lease, pays 6 per epoch, keeps its bond.
